stories.title: Product Safety Alert — 3 Recalls COS Parents Must Check Now

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: 3 COS parent alerts from CPSC this week: magnetic fidget toy recall (child swallowed magnet — can be fatal), infant walker recall (stair hazard), kids' pajamas recall (flammability risk). All sold online. Check cpsc.gov. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: CPSC recalled PIXLABBY magnetic fidget sliders — a child swallowed magnets. Stop use now. Also recalled: Wnttmt infant walkers (stair edge hazard) and Michley kids' pajamas (flammability). Check cpsc.gov. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
